mission.title: Sharing Supersnack!
mission.subtitle: Let's explore fractions by sharing equally.

rail.title: Fraction Rescue
rail.blurb: Help the crew share the supplies equally!

model.title: 1 Whole Energy Pizza
model.caption: This pizza will be shared equally.

prompt.statement: Four astronauts share one pizza equally.
prompt.question:
What do
you notice?

think_about.text: If something is shared equally, each person gets the same amount.

hints: Look at the pizza. How many equal parts could we make?
If we cut it into 4 equal parts, what fraction does each astronaut get?
Each astronaut gets one part out of four equal parts.

easier.statement: Two astronauts share one pizza equally.
easier.label: Sharing between 2

nova.speech: Let's find equal parts! Look closely and share fairly. 👀
nova.voice: Let's find equal parts. Look closely at the pizza and share it fairly.

questions.title: Spot the Mistake!
questions.instruction:
Look carefully.
Are these four parts equal?

models.label: Pizza
hints: Check the size of each part.
models.feedback_wrong: Hmm, look again at the crust. Is every slice the same size? 🔍

models.label: Chocolate bar
hints: Check the size of each chunk.
Compare the widest chunk with the narrowest.
models.feedback_wrong: Hmm, look again at the chunks. Is every chunk the same width? 🔍

models.label: Number line
hints: Check the size of each jump.
Look at the gaps between the marks.
Compare the longest jump with the shortest.
models.feedback_wrong: Hmm, look again at the jumps. Is every jump the same length? 🔍

questions.feedback_correct: Great observation! Not all four slices are the same. ✦

nova.voice: Look carefully. Are these four parts equal?

nova.speech: Awesome work, {name}! You're building real skills! 🌟

outcomes.heading: You understood
outcomes.description: You can identify and understand equal parts with confidence.

outcomes.description: You're getting better at representing fractions visually.
